items.q: How accurate is the broken link report?
items.a: It reports what each link returned at the time of the check. Some sites block automatic checkers, so links marked Check manually should be opened yourself.

items.q: How often should I check for broken links?
items.a: Check important pages every month, and after any redesign, migration or big content update. Fix 404s with a 301 redirect or a corrected link.

items.q: Is the broken link checker free?
items.a: Yes. The broken link checker is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: Is the page I enter stored?
items.a: The check runs through our server so it can read the page, and the result is shown to you. We do not require a login and the report can be downloaded as a CSV file.

items.q: Can you fix my website's broken links and SEO issues?
items.a: Yes. Our SEO team runs technical audits, and our website team can repair redirects and site structure.
